status: DRAFT. Not a preregistration until every REPLACE value is fixed and this file is committed before the first confirmation run.
task: tau2 retail, official train (74 tasks) and test (40 tasks) splits
hypothesis: From the same base model and the same rollout, token and optimizer-update budget, reinforcement learning on official train-task rewards resolves more held-out test tasks than fine-tuning on the base model's own successful train rollouts.

arms.prompted: Base model with the untrained adapter
arms.sft: Same rollout schedule sampled from the base model; imitate assistant turns of rollouts the official checker scored 1.0
arms.rl: Same rollout schedule; policy-gradient updates on the official checker's reward

development_seeds: REPLACE: seeds used for the preflight and tuning; excluded from confirmation
seeds: REPLACE: at least 5 confirmation seeds, disjoint from development seeds
primary: Paired difference in test-task success rate, rl minus sft, over every confirmation seed and all 40 test tasks, 4 trials per task aggregated within task.

analysis.success_rule: Positive mean difference, positive lower 95% bootstrap endpoint and two-sided seed sign-flip p <= 0.05. Both trained arms must complete the planned rollout and optimizer budgets. Any rollout the official checker fails to score aborts the seed; it is rerun with the original configuration, never counted as a failed task.

secondary: rl minus prompted and sft minus prompted, same analysis
Success on the test tasks an idle agent already passes, reported separately
Training rollouts, sampled action tokens, successful training rollouts and wall time per arm
deviations_from_official_tau2_scoring: The agent loop is this repository's text-action loop over tau2's gym interface, not `tau2 run` with native tool calling. The customer simulator, database, tools, policy and checker are tau2's.
judge_llm null keeps tau2's pinned judge. Any other value is a scoring deviation and must be reported as one.
scope: One domain, one base model. Fine-tuning here uses no human or reference demonstrations; a demonstration-trained baseline is a separate comparison. Not production or independent merchant evidence.
